name: io.github.drxinfra/rxmcp
title: Directum RX
description: Directum RX for AI assistants: assignments, documents, boards, projects, any entity, system help

environmentVariables.name: RXMCP_URL
environmentVariables.description: Directum RX integration service URL, for example https://rx.company.ru/Integration

environmentVariables.name: RXMCP_LOGIN
environmentVariables.description: Your Directum RX login: the server finds your assignments by it

environmentVariables.name: RXMCP_AUTH
environmentVariables.description: How to sign in: basic (login and password), cookie, oidc, bearer or header

environmentVariables.name: RXMCP_COOKIE
environmentVariables.description: Cookie header from the browser for RXMCP_AUTH=cookie (works with SSO and domain sign-in)

environmentVariables.name: RXMCP_ALLOW_WRITE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to enable write tools (tasks, assignments, board tickets). Read-only by default

environmentVariables.name: RXMCP_TZ
environmentVariables.description: Time zone for dates, for example Europe/Moscow
